reviews.title: Solid power supply
reviews.comment: Overall happy with this power supply. It's compact and quiet. I primarily buy Seasonic as they have never let me down. Can't beat the 10 year warranty and brand reputation. You never want to cheap out on a power supply.
reviews.author: SA

reviews.title: Absolute Power!!!!
reviews.comment:
It's Seasonic.  Prices being what they are right now Just buy it now and cry later.  When it comes to a power supply do not cheap out and buy from a less reputable brand to save a few bucks.  Bought this some months back to replace a ten year old PSU (from another reputable brand) that went bad due to an unforeseen encounter with a beetle (Don't ask).
The cables were long enough to reach everywhere in a rather tall and wide tower.  One negative is that the cables are stiffer are not sleeved which I know is the trend but I don't have a liking to that style.  Still they look okay and were no problem to deal with.  I inspected the cables and connectors a few weeks back and their are no sign of any problems.  I didn't expect any problems either but I always check.  Anyway happy building to fellow computer enthusiasts and newcomers to the addiction...I mean hobby.
reviews.author: AD2

reviews.title: Easy to Install
reviews.comment: Easy to install. I had no computer building experience prior to my previous power supply burning out after 6 years. Replaced it with this one, and the cables were labeled on the ends to make it easy to understand. It's so quiet compared to the old one, which a friend told me is typical for new PSUs. I've only had it a few months so far so I can't vouch for how quiet it will be over time.
reviews.author: Elle Estair

reviews.title: DEAD AFTER 8 MONTHS
reviews.comment:
DEAD AFTER 8 MONTHS
This isn't the first time I've bought a Seasonic PSU; I've had several, and I currently have a GX 750 that I've had since 2021 without any problems, so I decided to buy this updated version.
And everything was fine until today, when the computer, in a very strange way, started to slow down and emit a buzzing sound, before finally shutting down and emitting a burning smell, like cigarette smoke.
So I removed the PSU and tested it externally, but it wouldn't turn on anymore, not even the fan.
I put my old GX 750 back in the PC, and it booted normally, without any problems, pointing to the PSU having failed beyond repair.
While I process my RMA, which by the way, is unlikely to happen since I have to ship this part from another country, I'm buying a replacement CORSAIR RM850x and for the time being I won't be buying or recommending any Seasonic products again.
reviews.author: Juanjo S.
